subject: Accelerated escalation lane: discount request and invoice split proposal
messages:
From: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightcart.co>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Abby Singh <abby@brightcart.co>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accelerated escalation lane + discount for committed onboarding

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're moving rapidly on the POC and procurement asked whether Redwood can offer an "accelerated escalation lane" as part of our onboarding — essentially a guaranteed 30min triage window for severity-1 issues for the first 90 days, plus a one-time onboarding retainer.

Key asks from procurement:
- A 10% discount off list for the first-year committed spend if we sign by Aug 15.
- An invoice split option: BrightCart prefers 60/40 (60% on signature, 40% net-60) to align with budget cycles.
- A short SOW addendum describing the escalation lane and credits schedule.

Can you confirm if Redwood will accept these terms or provide an alternative? Also, we have a draft SOW attached (SOW_draft_v3.pdf).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Abby and I will be reviewing any counterproposal with Finance on Friday.

Best,
Tom
Tom Weaver
Head of Infrastructure, BrightCart
[attachment: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightcart.co>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: accelerated escalation lane + discount for committed onboarding

On Wed, Jul 28, 2027 at 9:12 AM Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightcart.co> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers...

Tom — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the SOW. Short answer: we can get close to what you asked for, with a couple of guardrails to keep the economics sustainable. Below is a counterproposal we can stand behind immediately; I'll loop legal if you want language in the SOW addendum.

High-level counterproposal (summary):
- Accelerated Escalation Lane: 30-minute triage for Sev-1 during business hours (M-F 6am-6pm PST) for the first 90 days; after that a standard 1-hour triage applies unless you buy the ongoing Premium Response add-on.
- Onboarding retainer: one-time USD 25k (covers dedicated war-room time and prioritized engineering capacity during ramp).
- Discount: 8% off list for Year 1 if BrightCart commits to a 12-month minimum spend of $450k.
- Invoice split: we can support a 60/40 split on signature/net-60, but it will reduce the discount by 1 percentage point (so net 7%) to cover payment timing risk.
- Credits: We will include the escalation credits table in the SOW (we'll send the Uptime_Tiers_Table.xlsx) that maps % credit to downtime windows; excluding user error or misconfiguration.

If that direction looks acceptable I can have Marcus produce a quote and Vanessa can draft the SOW addendum and credit table. Please note the discount is contingent on the 12-mo commitment and accepted SOW language around service exclusions.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the 60/40 invoice split with the 1-point discount reduction.
2) We'll issue an updated quote and SOW addendum (target: next business day).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps close this week.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Uptime_Tiers_Table.xlsx (xlsx, 80KB)]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: margin impact & alternative packaging for BRG-4931

Olga/Vanessa — quick internal note before we send numbers to BrightCart. Re the proposed terms:
- 8% list discount at $450k ARR yields a gross margin reduction of ~6.2% after expected cloud costs and support uplift. With the invoice split discount step-down to 7% the margin improves slightly.
- If they need stronger SLA windows beyond 90 days we should push the ongoing Premium Response add-on ($6k/mo) rather than bake the higher availability into the baseline.
- Consider offering a limited "ramp credit" of up to $10k applied to the first invoice in lieu of a deeper percentage discount — simpler accounting for both sides and protects our margin on longer-term usage growth.

Suggested external options to present (pick one):
A) Accept Olga's counter (7% with 60/40) + $25k retainer, no ramp credit.
B) 8% discount but require 75% upfront on signature (not acceptable to them based on prior thread).
C) 7% discount + $10k ramp credit applied to first invoice + 60/40 split.

My vote: C. Easier to explain to Finance and keeps ARR economics cleaner. If you want I can draft the quote spreadsheet with line items for retainer, ramp credit, and optional monthly Premium Response add-on.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: margin impact & alternative packaging for BRG-4931

Agree with Marcus — propose we present a single clean counter to BrightCart to avoid negotiation friction. Draft outline:
- 7% effective discount (60/40 split)
- $25k onboarding retainer (applied to services/first invoice)
- $10k ramp credit applied to first invoice (net applied before payment)
- 90-day accelerated lane (30-min triage business hours) after which standard SLA applies unless add-on purchased

I'll draft the SOW addendum and include explicit exclusion language (customer config, third-party infra) so credits are narrow. Olga, if you're comfortable with those terms I'll send the external email and attach the quote.

V.
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@brightcart.co>, Abby Singh <abby@brightcart.co>, procurement@brightcart.co
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Counterproposal: accelerated escalation lane, invoice split, and onboarding credits (BRG-4931)

Tom / Abby — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Below is Redwood's formal counterproposal for BrightCart based on your requests and a few conservative guardrails. We want this to be simple to approve on your side and predictable for us.

Commercial summary (final):
- Term: 12-month minimum commitment.
- Committed spend: $450,000 (Year 1 target).
- Effective discount: 7% off list for Year 1 (this reflects the invoice split concession).
- Invoice schedule: 60% due on signature; remaining 40% due net-60.
- Onboarding retainer: USD 25,000 (applied to first invoice).
- Ramp credit: USD 10,000 applied as a one-time credit to the first invoice (reduces cash due).

Operational SLA and credits:
- Accelerated Escalation Lane: 30-minute triage for Severity-1 incidents during business hours (M-F 6am-6pm PST) for the first 90 days following go-live.
- After 90 days, the standard 1-hour triage SLA applies unless BrightCart purchases Premium Response ($6,000/month).
- Credits: attached Uptime_Tiers_Table.xlsx describes credits by material outage windows. Credits excluded for customer misconfig, third-party outages, and scheduled maintenance with 48h notice.

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the commercial summary and invoice split by EOD Monday Aug 9 to lock the 7% pricing.
2) We will attach a concise SOW addendum and an updated quote (line items: list price, 7% discount, $25k retainer, $10k ramp credit) for signature.
3) If you prefer tighter 24/7 30-minute coverage beyond 90 days we can include an add-on — I cc'd Michael from our ops team to price that scenario.

If that path is acceptable I'll open the DocuSign envelope today and loop legal for final SOW language. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you want to review the invoice layout.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148
